text: The May3 migration first lets _onNsError accept either an nsresult number or a message key, then removes the numeric branch after the final callers change. The final historical handler reports NS_ERROR_FAILURE with a formatted message. Fixed source uses Fluent with named hostname, recipient and serverResponse fields. MAIL and RCPT still pass the original statusCode: a first4xx reconnects and returns before reporting, while a failed retry is reported. The separate _onError socket path preserves the platform event.errorCode and security context. MessageSend accepts the supplied generic-failure text; this does not make every transport failure generic. Current retry reset and listener-completion behavior are later source, not changes established by every migration entry. Source only: Bug 783526 comment 14 is unavailable; reviews are unread. No runtime validation.
title: Keep SMTP protocol text, retry input and socket results separate
